signals.title: Q3 forecast SEK 0.92B below budget — Gripen E/F acceptance milestones slip into 2027
signals.source: SDP Revenue Planning — hours burned × revenue per hour, by programme
signals.excerpt: The Q3 forecast lands at SEK 28.95B against a SEK 29.87B budget (−3.1%). Gripen E/F is SEK 617M behind as acceptance milestones move into 2027; T-7 (−SEK 107M) and Special Mission Platforms (−SEK 92M) follow. Gripen C/D & Support is close to plan (−SEK 29M).
